chunks: 211 - And ʿAmmār ibn Mūsā al-Sābāṭī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a woman who is afflicted by labor pains for a day, or two days, or more than that, and she sees yellowish discharge or blood: what should she do regarding salat (prayer)?
He said: “She performs salat (prayer) so long as she has not given birth; then if the pain overcomes her, she performs salat (prayer) when she recovers.”

key_terms.دَمًا: blood seen in this pre-birth state

ai.seo_question: Does a woman in labor stop praying before she actually gives birth?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman experiencing labor pains before childbirth while seeing yellowish discharge or blood. The Imam عليه السلام states that she remains obligated to perform salat (prayer) until actual birth occurs, and if intense pain overcomes her, she prays once she has recovered.
